addenda.expectation: Re-running the bridge matrix, both lifecycle fixtures and the unmodified-config arm inside unshare -rnm with an empty tmpfs mounted over $HOME/.mcporter (the shared daemon's socket path does not exist there) gives the same outcomes. A connect probe to the shared socket path inside the namespace returns ENOENT, while the same probe against the owned daemon socket connects. That owned control shows the probe detects a reachable socket. wong2 interactive listing is executed x3 for all 5 servers and renders at most one page (10 tools). With a lock holder that EXITS ON ITS OWN (sleep with a fixed lifetime, no harness kill), a call made while the lock is held times out after 45 s, a second call while still held also fails, and the first call after the holder exits succeeds with no step taken by the harness or the operator.
addenda.criteria: Gap 10 and the no-contact claim in the other receipts are settled only by the enforced (tmpfs + netns) runs with the probe and owned control recorded. Gap 12/6: settled only if every wong2 list arm executed (interactive), with incompleteness reported as a result. Gap 9: the startup-timeout conclusion is restated to match what the natural-expiry arm shows.
